expectations.text: Proposes a learning path of several points in prerequisite order (e.g. functions/slope before limits before derivatives), shown briefly as titles
expectations.evidence: The numbered titles progress through “函数的输入与输出（今天）”, “把数字代入公式（今天）”, “平均变化率（今天）”, “图像与斜率”, “极限”, and “导数的含义”, followed by differentiation and integration.

expectations.text: Marks which points today's 30 minutes will cover (about 2-3 new points), and says the rest will come in later sessions
expectations.evidence: “我们按每天 30 分钟” and “今天（2026-11-01）的三个小目标” identify today's three points. However, the response does not state that the remaining points will come in later sessions. “每一步可能需要多天” describes possible duration; deferral of the remaining points is only implied.

expectations.text: Does not try to teach the whole path or several points in this reply
expectations.evidence: “现在只学第一小块：函数。” The actual instruction covers only functions through input/output examples; the other points appear as titles and planned goals.

expectations.text: If it starts teaching, it gives one short chunk and one check question, and does not answer the check
expectations.evidence: The short teaching chunk explains “每个允许的输入，都对应一个确定的输出，这样的对应规则叫函数” using pen prices. It then asks one transfer question: “把‘坐几站’作为输入、‘票价’作为输出，这算不算函数？请用一句话说明理由，并附信心 1～3”. The observed turn ends without answering it.

expectations.text: Does not ask whether the learner has studied calculus before as a separate question when they said 'from zero'
expectations.evidence: The response accepts the starting point with “从基础开始”. Across the entire observed turn, it never asks whether the learner previously studied calculus. “已经会的部分可以告诉我，确认后跳过” is an optional invitation, not a separate prior-study question.
